title: App gets stuck on the loading spinner after refreshing the task list
body:
After the task list has loaded successfully, using the refresh action on the list screen causes the app to become permanently stuck on a loading spinner. The app has to be force-closed and reopened to recover.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Launch the app and wait for the task list to finish loading.
2. Tap the refresh icon in the app bar.
3. Observe the screen.

Expected behavior:
A brief loading spinner appears, and then the task list is shown again.

Actual behavior:
The loading spinner appears and never goes away. The task list is not shown again. No error message is displayed.

Additional context:
This reproduces 100% of the time. Other actions on the same screen work correctly. Switching between filter tabs before refreshing does not change the outcome. No exception or error is printed to the console.
